decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to manipulate the graveyard by cycling cards and utilizing the cascade mechanic to cast Living End, a powerful board wipe that brings back all creatures from the graveyard. The deck focuses on creating a critical mass of creatures in the graveyard, while also having disruption through counter spells like Force of Negation. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures, advantageously utilizing the cascade triggers to create a board state that is difficult for the opponent to recover from.

This Modern UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game with a combination of counterspells, removal, card draw, and planeswalkers. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while efficiently answering threats and card advantage. Teferi, Time Raveler and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria are key in this strategy, allowing the player to control the pace of the game and generate card advantage. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Supreme Verdict, along with powerful counterspells like Counterspell and Archmage's Charm to maintain control of the board.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to create a powerful synergy and toolbox effect. By using cards like Birds of Paradise and Ignoble Hierarch to ramp up quickly, the deck aims to summon creatures like Geralf's Messenger, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Grist, the Hunger Tide to control the board and drain opponents of life. Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution allow for flexibility in finding the right creatures for the situation, while the land base is optimized for consistent mana production. The deck thrives on efficiently tutoring and executing its combo pieces.

The deck focuses on using cards like Grief and Architects of Will to disrupt the opponent's hand and manipulate their own deck, while cycling through cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent to set up for a big combo finish with Living End. The creatures in the deck are mainly high-power, low-cost creatures that can be easily brought back from the graveyard with Living End, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Negation to protect their combo pieces and control the game until they can execute their combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to power through your library, generating card advantage while setting up a combo finish with Thassa's Oracle. By using cards like Mishra's Bauble, Mox Amber, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, you can continuously loop cards from your graveyard to the battlefield or hand, allowing you to generate a massive advantage and potentially win the game in one explosive turn. Additionally, cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early pressure and card selection to help you find your combo pieces quickly.

The main idea of this deck is to consistently cycle through your deck to fill your graveyard with powerful creatures, then use cards like Violent Outburst or Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield all at once. By controlling the board with disruption spells like Force of Negation and Grief, you can set up for a game-winning combo with creatures like Colossal Skyturtle and Waker of Waves. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a sudden surge of creatures while disrupting their game plan.

The main concept of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to quickly deploy a swarm of artifact creatures onto the battlefield, leveraging the affinity mechanic to reduce their casting costs. These cheap creatures are then equipped with powerful equipment like Cranial Plating and Shadowspear to become lethal threats. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast to generate card advantage and maintain a fast pace. Urza's Saga and Treasure Vault provide additional ramp and versatility to the deck, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with speed and aggression.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence with efficient and powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. This is supported by a suite of interactive spells such as Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early, control the game, and close out the game with its aggressive creatures.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp quickly through land drops and creature tutors to assemble a winning combo using Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan. The deck focuses on setting up the combo as fast as possible by utilizing cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Arboreal Grazer to accelerate mana production and trigger multiple land drops per turn. Once the combo is in place, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful land-based threats like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Cultivator Colossus.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize artifacts and Urza, Lord High Artificer to control the game through various means. This includes using artifacts such as Springleaf Drum, Nettlecyst, and Ornithopter to generate mana and card advantage, as well as using Urza's Saga to fetch powerful artifacts. The deck also includes disruption elements like Pithing Needle and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of card advantage, mana generation, and disruption.

This deck aims to leverage the power of Indomitable Creativity to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty while using a mix of control spells and Planeswalkers to control the game. The deck also includes a land package that allows for flexibility and consistency in mana fixing. The main goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up a game-winning combo with Indomitable Creativity, showcasing a unique and creative approach to gameplay.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. It also makes use of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to control the opponent's resources while maintaining tempo. The inclusion of cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Mishra's Bauble allows for further card advantage and flexibility in the deck's strategy. The deck aims to win through aggressive early-game plays and efficient disruption to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing Elemental creatures and powerful spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With powerful cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude, as well as supportive cards like Risen Reef and Unsettled Mariner, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds another element of synergy to the deck, further enhancing its control capabilities. Overall, the deck prioritizes disruption and value generation to secure victory in a 1 vs 1 format.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly pressure the opponent. It utilizes efficient removal like Fatal Push, Lightning Bolt, and Terminate to control the board while cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek disrupt the opponent's hand. The deck also includes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, disruptive, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to establish control over the game through countering opponent's spells, removal, and card draw. Using powerful control cards like Archmage's Charm, Counterspell, and Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Spreading Seas and Shark Typhoon to generate additional value and pressure. With planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck can further control the board and outvalue the opponent. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and winning through incremental advantage.
